1
GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
(Chairperson, District Child Protection Society)
Notification No.04/CHL/2026 Dated: 08.10.2026
Sub: Mission Vatsalya – Child Helpline 1098, Jangaon – Engagement of personnel in all
eight posts on outsourcing basis – Written examination on Thursday, the 15th October
2026 – Notification issued.
Ref: 1. Standard Operating Procedures of the Child Helpline under Mission Vatsalya,
Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India.
2. Lr.No.959/MV/2023, dated 24.05.2023 of the Commissioner, Women
Development and Child Welfare, Hyderabad.
3. Notification No.02/WCD/2026, dated 05.10.2026 of the Collector, Jangaon, for
selection of the outsourcing agency.
4. Proceedings Rc.No.COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026, dated 08.10.2026 of the
Collector, Jangaon, on the posts of the Child Helpline.
* * *
1. The Child Helpline 1098, Jangaon, works round the clock under Mission Vatsalya as a
unit of the District Child Protection Unit. All eight posts of the Helpline are to be filled
afresh by open selection, as ordered in the reference fourth cited. Applications are invited
from eligible candidates for engagement, on outsourcing basis, in the posts shown below.

Consolidated
remuneration per
month
1 Project Coordinator 1 Men and women Rs.28,000
2 Counsellor 1 Men and women Rs.18,536
3 Child Helpline Supervisor 3 Men and women Rs.19,500
4 Case Worker 3 Men and women Rs.15,600
2. The qualification and experience for each post are those laid down in the Standard
Operating Procedures first cited and communicated in the reference second cited. They
will not be relaxed. A higher qualification in the same subject is accepted in place of the
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6482/2026

degree prescribed. The qualification and experience shall be held on the date of this
notification.

Proficiency in computers.
Case Worker Pass in Class XII from a recognised
Board, or its equivalent.
Good communication skills.
Weightage for experience.
Proficiency in computers.
For every post the procedures prefer persons who have worked in an emergency helpline.
The preference is given in the manner stated in para 5(h).
3. A candidate shall have completed 21 years and shall not have completed 35 years of age
on 01.10.2026. The upper age limit is relaxed by five years for candidates of the
Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Backward Classes, and by ten years for persons
with benchmark disabilities. It does not apply to persons now working in the Helpline.
4. Experience will be counted only where the certificate shows the post held and the dates
of joining and relieving, and is supported by the appointment order and proof of payment
such as bank statement, pay slips or EPF record. Field work, project work or internship
done as a student, and voluntary service, will not be counted. A certificate issued by a
non-Government organisation shall carry the registration number of the organisation and,
where it has one, its NGO Darpan identity number. Every certificate relied upon will be
referred to the issuing authority for confirmation.
5. Selection will be by a written examination followed, on the same day, by an oral test of
25 marks. The selection list will be declared the same day.
(a) For the posts at Sl.No.1 to 3 the written examination carries 200 objective questions
for 90 minutes, in English. Part A of 100 questions is common to these posts. Part
B of 100 questions is on the work of the post applied for.
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6482/2026
3
(b) For the post at Sl.No.4 the written examination carries 100 objective questions for
60 minutes, in English and Telugu.
(c) In every paper each question has five options and carries one mark. One fourth of
a mark will be deducted for every wrong answer. Nothing is deducted for a question
left unanswered. Answers are marked on an OMR answer sheet. The syllabus is in
Annexure II.
(d) For the posts of Child Helpline Supervisor and Case Worker, for which the
procedures give weightage to experience, two marks will be added for each
completed year of paid work in child protection or in an emergency helpline, up to
ten marks.
(e) The key will be displayed at the venue at 12.00 noon on the day of the examination.
Objections to the key, in writing and with proof, will be received at the venue up
to 12.45 PM and decided before the result is declared.
(f) The result of the written examination will be displayed at the venue at 2.00 PM.
Candidates will be called the same day for verification of original certificates and
the oral test, in the order of marks, at three candidates for each vacancy. Every
candidate shall therefore bring all original certificates to the venue and remain there
till the result is displayed. A candidate who is absent when called, does not produce
the originals, or is found not eligible, will be passed over and the next candidate
called. No other date will be given.
(g) In the oral test each candidate will answer five questions drawn from a question
bank. Each answer will be marked out of five by the Selection Committee on a
scoring sheet, which forms part of the record.
(h) The selection list for each post will be drawn in the order of the total marks. Where
the total is equal, a candidate who has done paid work in an emergency helpline
(1098, 112, 181 or 108) will be placed higher; then the candidate with more marks
in the written examination; and then the candidate older in age. The list will be
declared the same evening. Orders of engagement will issue on the next day, the
16.10.2026, for every candidate on whom the report of the Police is received. The
engagement is subject to confirmation of the certificates by the issuing authorities;
where a certificate is not confirmed the engagement ends without notice. A waiting
list will be kept for one year.
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6482/2026

7. Applications in the form in Annexure I, with self attested copies of the certificates listed
in it and two passport size photographs, shall be handed over at the Inward Section of the
Collectorate, Integrated District Offices Complex, Jangaon, from 09.10.2026 to
14.10.2026, between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM on working days and between 10.30 AM
and 1.00 PM on Saturday, the 10.10.2026. The hall ticket will be issued across the counter
on receipt of the application. Applications sent by registered post or speed post shall
reach the Collectorate by 5.00 PM on 14.10.2026, and the cover shall be superscribed
with the name of the post. Applications will not be received at the office of the District
Welfare Officer or at the Helpline. A candidate may apply for one post only. The written
examinations under Notifications No.04/CHL/2026, No.05/CH/2026 and
No.06/DHEW/2026 are held at the same hour on the same day, and a candidate may
apply under only one of them. There is no application fee.
8. Admission to the written examination is provisional. The venue will be announced on
the district website https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board of the
Collectorate by 13.10.2026. Candidates who applied by post shall collect the hall ticket
at the help desk at the venue between 8.30 AM and 9.15 AM on the day of the
examination, on production of an identity card. The candidate shall bring the hall ticket,
an identity card in original, all original certificates and a blue or black ball point pen, and
shall report by 9.00 AM. No candidate will be admitted after 9.45 AM. Mobile phones,
calculators and other electronic devices are not allowed in the examination hall.
9. The conditions of engagement are as follows.
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6482/2026
5
(a) The person selected will be engaged on outsourcing basis through the agency
selected by the Collector under Notification No.02/WCD/2026, which will pay the
remuneration and remit the contributions to EPF and ESI. The selection,
continuance and removal of the person rest with the Collector. The agency has no
part in them.
(b) The engagement is for one year at a time, and in the first instance up to 31.03.2027.
It is not service under the Government and confers no right to regularisation.
Continuance depends on the annual appraisal of performance, on the continuance
of the scheme and on the release of funds. The engagement may be ended at any
time as provided in the agreement with the agency.
(c) The work is full time. The Helpline works round the clock, and the persons engaged
shall work in shifts, at night and on holidays, as the roster requires.
(d) Verification of antecedents by the Police is mandatory before engagement, as laid
down in the procedures first cited. Candidates called for the oral test shall give the
particulars required for it to the Police team at the venue.
(e) The persons engaged shall keep the records of children and of callers confidential
and shall take up no other employment. Every person engaged is bound by section
19 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012 to report any
offence against a child that comes to his or her knowledge.
(f) Persons who have worked or are working in the Helpline may apply for any one
post for which they hold the qualification. Their service in the Helpline counts as
experience. No preference will be given to them beyond what is stated in this
notification.
(g) Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. A candidate who furnishes a
false certificate or suppresses any fact will be removed at any stage and is liable to
prosecution.
(h) No travelling allowance will be paid for attending the examination or the oral test.
10. The rule of reservation, including the reservation for women and for persons with
disabilities, and the Telangana Public Employment (Organisation of Local Cadres and
Regulation of Direct Recruitment) Order 2018 will be followed. A roster is opened for
each category with this selection. The posts of Project Coordinator and Counsellor are
single posts, and each falls at the first point of its roster, which is open competition. For
the three posts each of Child Helpline Supervisor and Case Worker, the points of the
roster that fall to them will be certified by the establishment section of the Collectorate
and displayed at the venue before the written examination. Local candidates of Jangaon
District, as defined in that Order, will be selected first in the order of merit. A candidate
who is not local will be considered only where no local candidate is found eligible.
11. The Collector may modify or cancel this notification or vary the number of posts.
12. The key, results and all notices will be placed on the district website and on the notice
board of the Collectorate. No individual intimation will be sent.

Post Syllabus
Project Coordinator
Management of a helpline unit that works round the clock; shift rosters
and supervision; handling of emergency, non-emergency and information
calls as the procedures lay down; follow up and closure of cases within
the timelines; coordination with the Police, health, labour, railways,
transport and the Child Welfare Committee; the resource directory; data,
reports and the Mission Vatsalya portal; plans for awareness and outreach;
training of staff; confidentiality of records.
Counsellor
Child and adolescent development; counselling of children in crisis, in
person and on the telephone; abuse, neglect and trauma and their effects;
psychological first aid; assessment of risk, including the risk of self-harm,
and referral; counselling of runaway, missing and married children and of
their families; support to child victims under the POCSO Act; ethics,
consent and confidentiality; documentation.
Child Helpline Supervisor
Receipt, triage and recording of calls; case management and follow up
within the timelines; rescue and outreach with the Police and other
departments; production of children before the Child Welfare Committee;
case files and documentation; spreadsheets, email and online portals;
supervision of a shift; the law relevant to interventions; confidentiality.

OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
Notification No.04/CHL/2026, dated 08.10.2026
Applications are invited for engagement on outsourcing basis in all eight posts of the Child
Helpline 1098, Jangaon, under Mission Vatsalya: Project Coordinator (1), Counsellor (1),
Child Helpline Supervisor (3) and Case Worker (3). Age: 21 to 35 years as on 01.10.2026,
relaxable by five years for SC, ST and BC and by ten years for persons with disabilities.
Selection is by a written examination with negative marking on Thursday, 15.10.2026, at 10.00
AM, with the oral test and the result on the same day and orders of engagement on the next
day. Candidates shall bring their original certificates. Applications in the prescribed form will
be received at the Inward Section of the Collectorate, IDOC, Jangaon, from 09.10.2026 up to
5.00 PM on 14.10.2026, and hall tickets will be issued across the counter. Persons working in
the Helpline may also apply. The qualifications, syllabus, form of application and conditions
are in the detailed notification on https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board of
the Collectorate.
Collector and District Magistrate, Jangaon
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6482/2026
